title: Chad Chops a Yam
lines: Dad and Chad walk to a shop with Meg.
They get a big yam and a bun.
At the hut, Chad chops chips from the yam.
Dad gets a pan hot and tips them in.
"Such a rich dish!" said Meg, his chum.
Meg has much of it, and Chad has less.
A chip is on his chin.
Meg chops the bun. Chad has the big bit.

questions.listenFor: Dad does. Chad chops, Dad cooks - two jobs, two people. Have them find the line with pan in it.

questions.ask: Why does Chad get the big bit of the bun?
questions.listenFor: Meg ate most of the chips and Chad only had one, on his chin, so she made it fair. You want cause and effect, not just "she was nice."

questions.ask: Was that a fair thing for Meg to do? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Listen for a reason from the story, like "yes, because Chad had hardly any chips left."
